verdict.rationale: Cognee ships an official MCP server documented to connect Claude, Cursor, Cline, Continue, and Codex to the same persistent memory store, directly matching the 'shared memory across assistants' story. However, ChatGPT is never listed among supported MCP clients, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence confirming multi-tool memory sharing actually works in practice. Missing for 10: explicit ChatGPT/MCP support confirmation, independent verification of cross-tool memory sharing in real use.
